package main

// The rejudge command (RB9-F6 TS port, step 3): the Go-written byte corpora keep their cases and their bases and take the verdicts of a validator whose
// rule moved. F-VE-2 (b) (the offline walk requires the genesis link of every evidence 2.1 document, judged LAST) can only move a case the old validator
// VERIFIED - a document refused earlier, or by a named state of verify21, keeps its refusal - so the cases to judge again are the verified ones, plus a
// deterministic sample of the others that proves the rule (a sample case that moves is an error).
//
//	XTS_CORPUS=go-written/bytes-cases-pathspell.json.gz XTS_MODE=verified XTS_SHARD=i/n ./xtsgen -fixtures $S3 -out <dir> rejudge
//	    writes <dir>/<corpus>.rejudge.<i>.json: for every selected case (every n-th from the i-th) the verdict now, and the verdict before
//	XTS_CORPUS=... ./xtsgen -fixtures $S3 -out <dir> rejudgemerge
//	    reads <dir>/<corpus>.rejudge.*.json, applies them to the corpus, judges the bases again, writes <dir>/<corpus> and prints what moved
//
// Every verdict is produced by the validator's own functions (judgeStable, as the generators use), the file is written by the generators' own writer, and a
// corpus that nothing moved in is byte-identical to the one it was read from.

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"math/rand"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

type rejudgeOne struct {
	Idx    int    `json:"idx"`
	Old    Expect `json:"old"`
	New    Expect `json:"new"`
	Sample bool   `json:"sample,omitempty"`
}

func shardOf() (int, int, error) {
	i, n := 0, 1
	if v := os.Getenv("XTS_SHARD"); v != "" {
		parts := strings.Split(v, "/")
		if len(parts) != 2 {
			return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("XTS_SHARD %q: want i/n", v)
		}
		i, _ = strconv.Atoi(parts[0])
		n, _ = strconv.Atoi(parts[1])
	}
	return i, n, nil
}

func readByteFile(fixtures string) (*ByteFile, string, error) {
	rel := os.Getenv("XTS_CORPUS")
	if rel == "" {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("XTS_CORPUS is not set")
	}
	raw, err := readDoc(filepath.Join(fixtures, rel))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	f := new(ByteFile)
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, f); err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	return f, rel, nil
}

func rejudgeCorpus(fixtures, out string) error {
	f, rel, err := readByteFile(fixtures)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	si, sn, err := shardOf()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	sample := 0
	if m := os.Getenv("XTS_MODE"); strings.HasPrefix(m, "sample:") {
		sample, _ = strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimPrefix(m, "sample:"))
	}
	// the selection: every verified case, and a deterministic sample of the others
	var sel []int
	others := []int{}
	for i, c := range f.Cases {
		if c.Expect.V == "verified" {
			sel = append(sel, i)
		} else {
			others = append(others, i)
		}
	}
	isSample := map[int]bool{}
	if sample > 0 && len(others) > 0 {
		r := rand.New(rand.NewSource(seedOf(rel, "sample")))
		r.Shuffle(len(others), func(a, b int) { others[a], others[b] = others[b], others[a] })
		if sample > len(others) {
			sample = len(others)
		}
		picked := others[:sample]
		sort.Ints(picked)
		for _, i := range picked {
			isSample[i] = true
			sel = append(sel, i)
		}
		sort.Ints(sel)
	}
	docs := map[int][]byte{}
	var res []rejudgeOne
	for k, idx := range sel {
		if k%sn != si {
			continue
		}
		c := f.Cases[idx]
		base, ok := docs[c.Base]
		if !ok {
			base, err = baseDoc(fixtures, f.Bases[c.Base])
			if err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", f.Bases[c.Base], err)
			}
			docs[c.Base] = base
		}
		e, ok := judgeStable(applyEdits(base, c.Edits))
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("case %s: Go panicked or answered differently on two runs (%s)", c.ID, lastPanic)
		}
		res = append(res, rejudgeOne{Idx: idx, Old: c.Expect, New: e, Sample: isSample[idx]})
	}
	return writeJSON(filepath.Join(out, filepath.Base(rel)+fmt.Sprintf(".rejudge.%d.json", si)), res)
}

func rejudgeMerge(fixtures, out string) error {
	f, rel, err := readByteFile(fixtures)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	matches, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(out, filepath.Base(rel)+".rejudge.*.json"))
	sort.Strings(matches)
	if len(matches) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("no %s.rejudge.*.json in %s", filepath.Base(rel), out)
	}
	moved, same, sampled, sampleMoved := 0, 0, 0, 0
	kinds := map[string]int{}
	for _, m := range matches {
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(m)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		var res []rejudgeOne
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &res); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, r := range res {
			if r.Sample {
				sampled++
			}
			if sameVerdict(r.Old, r.New) {
				same++
				continue
			}
			if r.Sample {
				sampleMoved++
			}
			moved++
			msg := r.New.Msg
			if len(msg) > 36 {
				msg = msg[:36]
			}
			kinds[fmt.Sprintf("%s -> %s %q (evLen same: %v)", r.Old.V, r.New.V, msg, r.Old.EvLen == r.New.EvLen)]++
			f.Cases[r.Idx].Expect = r.New
		}
	}
	// the bases are judged again: a base document that moved takes its new verdict
	baseMoved := 0
	for bi, bpath := range f.Bases {
		raw, err := baseDoc(fixtures, bpath)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", bpath, err)
		}
		be, ok := judgeStable(raw)
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: Go is unstable on the base document", bpath)
		}
		a, _ := json.Marshal(f.BaseExpect[bi])
		b, _ := json.Marshal(be)
		if string(a) != string(b) {
			baseMoved++
		}
		f.BaseExpect[bi] = be
	}
	fmt.Printf("%s: judged again %d (%d verdicts unchanged, %d moved; sample of %d others: %d moved), bases moved %d of %d\n", rel, same+moved, same, moved, sampled, sampleMoved, baseMoved, len(f.Bases))
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(kinds))
	for k := range kinds {
		keys = append(keys, k)
	}
	sort.Strings(keys)
	for _, k := range keys {
		fmt.Printf("    %6d  %s\n", kinds[k], k)
	}
	if sampleMoved > 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%d of the sampled non-verified cases moved: the premise (only a verified case can move) does not hold", sampleMoved)
	}
	return writeJSON(filepath.Join(out, filepath.Base(rel)), f)
}

// sameVerdict: the verdict a corpus records. A plain refusal is recorded by its class (the consumers compare the class), except a certify state, which carries its
// name and fields; the wording of a JSON syntax error is not part of the verdict.
func sameVerdict(a, b Expect) bool {
	if a.V != b.V || a.EvLen != b.EvLen {
		return false
	}
	switch a.V {
	case "verified":
		x, _ := json.Marshal(a.Summary)
		y, _ := json.Marshal(b.Summary)
		return string(x) == string(y)
	case "named":
		x, _ := json.Marshal(a.State)
		y, _ := json.Marshal(b.State)
		return string(x) == string(y)
	}
	certify := func(m string) string {
		if strings.HasPrefix(m, "certify_") {
			if i := strings.Index(m, "}"); i > 0 {
				return m[:i]
			}
		}
		return ""
	}
	return certify(a.Msg) == certify(b.Msg)
}

// roundTrip reads the corpus and writes it back unchanged (the writer's identity on a file it wrote).
func roundTrip(fixtures, out string) error {
	f, rel, err := readByteFile(fixtures)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return writeJSON(filepath.Join(out, filepath.Base(rel)), f)
}
